ruleDefinitions.name: Download From Suspicious TLD - Blacklist
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects download of certain file types from hosts in suspicious TLDs Note: Unmapped fields: c-uri-extension, cs-host

sequences.query: ((c-uri-extension = "exe" OR c-uri-extension = "vbs" OR c-uri-extension = "bat" OR c-uri-extension = "rar" OR c-uri-extension = "ps1" OR c-uri-extension = "doc" OR c-uri-extension = "docm" OR c-uri-extension = "xls" OR c-uri-extension = "xlsm" OR c-uri-extension = "pptm" OR c-uri-extension = "rtf" OR c-uri-extension = "hta" OR c-uri-extension = "dll" OR c-uri-extension = "ws" OR c-uri-extension = "wsf" OR c-uri-extension = "sct" OR c-uri-extension = "zip") AND (cs-host = RGX("\\\.country$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.stream$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.gdn$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.mom$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.xin$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.kim$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.men$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.loan$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.download$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.racing$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.online$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.science$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ren$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.gb$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.win$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.top$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.review$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.vip$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.party$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.tech$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.xyz$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.date$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.faith$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.zip$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.cricket$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.space$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.info$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.vn$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.cm$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.am$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.cc$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.asia$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ws$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.tk$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.biz$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.su$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.st$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ro$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ge$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ms$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.pk$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.nu$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.me$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ph$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.to$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.tt$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.name$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.tv$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.kz$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.tc$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.mobi$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.study$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.click$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.link$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.trade$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.accountant$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.cf$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.gq$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ml$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ga$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.pw$")))
